entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states with support for temporal reasoning. It is available as an official Hermes Agent provider in both a managed cloud version and an Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS server.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to provide sub-300ms recall for massive token volumes. It supports automated fact extraction across diverse integrations like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub while offering multi-modal extractors for non-text media.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that manages agent memories and skills through a filesystem-inspired paradigm. It utilizes a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system to achieve significant token reduction and improved task completion rates.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesis and gap analysis for queried data. It is designed for flexible deployment, supporting both local PGLite instances and remote server environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight offers a long-term memory workflow focused on retain, recall, and reflect operations to help agents learn over time. It provides developers with Python and Node.js SDKs alongside Docker-based deployment options for easy integration.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that enables stateful agents through peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It serves as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers and offers both a managed service and a self-hosted FastAPI backend.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink for managing agent context.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency system that uses a SQLite backend to deliver sub-millisecond memory performance without external service requirements. It includes a TripleStore for temporal knowledge graph management and is compatible with MCP clients and Python agents.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving context harness uses a filesystem-first approach to generate traces, reports, and playbooks for complex tasks. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and includes built-in MCP server capabilities.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin implements a lossless context engine using a DAG-based message store to ensure no history is ever discarded. It builds depth-aware summary DAGs for compacted history and provides specialized tools for searching and expanding context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for Honcho to enable private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur introduces a shared memory layer that uses an open YAML engram format to store knowledge as plain-text on local disks. It supports hierarchical scoping for global or project-specific knowledge and is compatible with various coding agents and the OpenClaw ecosystem.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet offers a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across multiple agent harnesses and MCP clients. It prioritizes local custody of secrets and memory files, providing a dedicated dashboard for inspection and repair.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that uses hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and vector search without cloud dependencies. It captures agent decisions using a local GGUF observer model and integrates via MCP or Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization plugin accelerates inference by reordering blocks and deduplicating context to maximize prefix reuse. It is designed to reduce prefill latency and save tokens within the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes an SDK, CLI, MCP server, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a reason and tracking contradictions in stored information. It features a self-directing loop that identifies knowledge gaps and performs recency-based ranking.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a unified stack. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with a purpose-built evidence packet for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to predict future data needs. It uses local-first storage with SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration with coding agents.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal for semantic discovery. It features automated indexing for code and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only the most relevant tool schemas for a given task. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, ensuring agents only load the specific context they need. It implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to significantly reduce prompt tokens with zero millisecond overhead.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless provider uses a user's own Obsidian vault as the source of truth for cross-project memory. It stores data as canonical Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable cache for semantic and BM25 retrieval.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a columnar embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via a 1-10 importance ranking system. It supports BM25 keyword search and optional entity extraction to organize named relationships between entries.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin features an audit log of every operation and supports immediate, real deletion of events. It was developed as a community fix to provide on-demand summarization without persistent summaries affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory with semantic search and provenance tracking for agent interactions. It automatically mirrors native Hermes memory tools and supports session snapshots with TTL-based storage.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail is a specialized SDK and MCP server that allows agents to manage payments and charge for API usage across multiple blockchain families. It integrates with Hermes and other agent frameworks to enable financial autonomy using USDC and stablecoins.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A within Hermes. It requires a local SourceVault server and supports various interfaces including CLI, Telegram, and Desktop.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers a suite of 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management using hybrid search methods. It features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve essential information.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB provides AI-native long-term memory with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval signals including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It supports metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication, operating as either an embedded library or a standalone daemon.

entries.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology utilizing a subagent-driven-development process. It includes skills for brainstorming and planning while emphasizing red/green TDD and YAGNI.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It is compatible with various coding agents and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, including Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills cover 29 security domains and are compatible with Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A tool that generates editable.drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It supports 11 diagram type presets and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing and rewriting tool designed to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a 111-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes and supports a two-pass detection system.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement. It enables collective skill evolution and unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library featuring 50 expert frameworks and 12 metaskills designed to orchestrate business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce providing adjudication for deals through natural-language mandates and escrow. It includes a master router, connector skills, and official protocol skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation alongside management slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Implements the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI to provide type-safe support. It reduces token usage through progressive disclosure of skill metadata.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A skill set that enables Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts via dynamic custom analytical lenses. It includes seven pre-built prisms and a constraint reporting feature to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that provides structured memory and a three-level work model. It supports file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A plugin for self-memory and replacement models that uses markdown files for cross-instance shared memory. It automates the capture of high-value decisions to facilitate fine-tuning replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Interoperable skills following the agentskills.io specification for interacting with the Oracle network and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official image generation skills for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It provides standardized prompting guidelines and API integration patterns for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance via file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a Python SkilldockClient, a CLI, and commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: A skill for autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks. It features real-time progress tracking, checkpoints, and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It uses a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A local-first workflow language implemented as a single Rust binary. It provides static auditing for cost, secrets, and types, and generates hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer intelligent skill retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and tracks quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial bug-hunting skill that uses three parallel subagents to analyze code for edge cases and exploitability. It is a read-only tool that integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io with MCP integration. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automatic registration of common skill directories.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: A skill that implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill using a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It includes a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and features federated search.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A skill compatible with Hermes Agent and agentskills.io that automates payments for HTTP 402 responses. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols using USDC.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports from global to street level. It includes quality gates and AI analysis for core conclusions and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes. It includes various CLI and desktop tools that are updated daily.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and provides configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installation for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for sandboxing Hermes Agent via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis within a financial trading context. It supports multiple LLM providers and utilizes a structured workflow for research debates and risk management approval.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration tool manages task assignment, execution review, and completion receipts through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It includes a memory browser and a relationship graph to monitor agent workflows and spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and mobile-friendly web dashboard for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It utilizes Docker sandboxing and git worktrees to ensure agent isolation.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control room template employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for visualizing tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This project implements ACP-style delegation to route tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It includes an auto-syncing local index and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs. It supports integrations for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows users to inspect system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses for Hermes Agent and other agents. It enables debugging by comparing adjacent requests and exporting portable HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for building and operating apps. It supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community CLI skins and themes designed to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents that provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments and supports identity registration with @handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance, with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configuration and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated installation tool that deploys a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configs, system prompts, and tool descriptions that runs without API calls. It uses structural heuristics and regex to support JSON, YAML, Markdown, and.prompt files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool that transfers OpenClaw configs, credentials, skills, and memory archives into Hermes YAML and JSON formats. It also sets up systemd gateway services during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: A self-healing observability tool for multi-agent systems that operates without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin for exporting telemetry and provides automated health monitoring and token intelligence tracking.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that unifies Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent. It provides a single application to manage multiple AI agents and CLI tools across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that unifies multiple CLI agents, including Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, into one interface. It features a built-in agent engine with zero configuration and automates document creation for Word, Excel, and PPT.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface accessible via browser or SSH tunnel that utilizes existing Hermes agents and models without additional setup. It features a three-panel layout designed for chat and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and chats across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard providing multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and includes an integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that enables direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects the active browser context to a local, remote, or Hermes Cloud runtime. It provides a full-page Hermes Web workspace.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows and macOS desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that supports Codex, Claude, OpenCode, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot CLI. It provides session search, transcript inspection, and a live per-session quota burn-rate meter.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace for interacting with Hermes Agent on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: A terminal dashboard built with OpenTUI that consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration. It includes integrated kanban boards and an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with file attachments and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools, such as TTS and ComfyUI, and a workflow engine for multi-step automation pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent chat and real-time log streaming. It incorporates a task tracking dashboard, file browser, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time visibility into session activity, cost tracking, and conversation history, alongside read-only access to environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes a marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for model switching.
